page.title: My PEA
page.subtitle: Account value, deposits and performance, cash movements and full history.

metrics.historyIncomplete: History summarized by the initial state: performance is indicative and the annualized IRR is not computed.
metrics.ceilingHint: Legal ceiling of {{ceiling}} on deposits into a standard PEA; withdrawals do not restore it.

pending.title: PEA cash account to set up
pending.description: Deposits and purchases are now distinguished. Enter your cash balance and historical deposits for accurate indicators.

funding.title: Insufficient cash balance
funding.question: Did you make a deposit into your PEA that is not recorded yet? You can record it now, together with the operation.
funding.dateNote: The deposit will be dated {{date}} and recorded together with the operation: if either fails, neither is kept.
funding.amountTooLow: The deposit must cover at least {{amount}}.
funding.notFundable: This operation would make the cash balance negative and cannot be funded by a deposit. Correct it or first change the related operations.

setup.title: New: your PEA cash account
setup.intro: A purchase is no longer treated as a deposit. Your PEA now has a cash account: deposits fund it, purchases use it, sales and dividends credit it.
setup.reinvest: Selling then buying again (reinvesting) uses the available cash without increasing your total deposits.
setup.missing: Your historical deposits cannot be derived from your past purchases. Enter them from your statement; they are never rebuilt automatically.
setup.positionsCost: For reference, the cost basis of your current positions is {{amount}} (this is not your total deposits).
setup.referenceHint: Earlier operations are summarized by this initial state and are not counted twice.
setup.editDescription: Correct the initial values at any time: balances are recomputed and every change is logged.
setup.none: No initial state: the balance is computed since opening from recorded movements only.

movement.title: Record a movement
movement.withdrawalWarning: Note: before 5 years, a withdrawal normally closes the PEA; after 5 years, withdrawn gains remain subject to social contributions. Exact rules depend on your situation: no tax is computed here.
movement.dividendHint: Enter here a credited dividend that was not proposed. Dividends paid on your holdings are proposed automatically on their payment date and are only credited once you confirm them.
movement.otherCreditHint: A capital repayment or a compensation is neither a deposit nor a dividend: it increases the balance without affecting the ceiling. Before the initial state date, it is summarized by it and deducted from dividends already received.
movement.ceilingExceeded: This deposit would exceed the {{ceiling}} deposit ceiling.

ledger.title: Movement history
ledger.deleteDescription: Delete this {{amount}} movement dated {{date}}? Later balances will be recomputed.

hints.peaValue: Positions at the last price + cash balance. What the PEA would be worth if you sold everything now (before fees).
hints.positionsValue: Quantity held × last known price for each line. Without a price, the cost basis is used.
hints.cash: Uninvested money in the PEA cash account: deposits + sales + received dividends - purchases - fees - withdrawals. Recomputed from the history.
hints.costBasis: Amount paid for the securities still held (average cost × quantity), purchase fees included. This is not your total deposits.
hints.deposits: Total transfers into the PEA since opening. A purchase, sale, dividend or gain never increases it.
hints.withdrawals: Total money taken out of the PEA. Withdrawals do not erase historical deposits.
hints.netDeposits: Total deposits - total withdrawals: the money you actually left in the PEA.
hints.remainingCeiling: €150,000 - total deposits. Only deposits count: reinvested dividends and gains do not use the ceiling, and a withdrawal does not restore it.
hints.globalGain: PEA value + withdrawals - deposits: what the PEA has earned overall (realized and unrealized gains, dividends, net of fees). The % is relative to net deposits.
hints.latentGain: Paper gain or loss on the securities still held: current value - cost basis. It moves with prices until you sell.
hints.realizedGain: Gain or loss locked in by your sales: sale price - average cost of the shares sold - fees. Sale proceeds are already in the cash balance.
hints.cashDividends: Dividends actually credited to the cash account (net amount, after any foreign withholding tax): entered manually, proposed then confirmed, added automatically when certain, and those received before the initial state if you confirmed them. They never count as deposits nor towards the ceiling.
hints.otherCredits: Capital repayments (share premium, capital reduction) and compensations (fractional rights of a bonus share allotment, cash adjustment) credited since the initial state. They increase the cash balance but are neither deposits (ceiling, annualized return) nor dividends.
hints.estimatedDividends: Estimate of dividends received since your purchases: dividends published by Yahoo Finance × quantity held on each ex-date. Gross amount, not recorded in cash.
hints.yieldOnCost: Expected annual dividend at the current rate, relative to the cost basis of your positions. Accumulating ETFs pay nothing and lower this rate.
hints.fees: Brokerage fees on purchases and sales + standalone fees entered in the cash ledger.
hints.withholding: Tax withheld by the company's country (from the ISIN prefix, otherwise from the listing venue). In a PEA it can neither be reclaimed nor offset. French taxation only applies on withdrawal and is not deducted here.
hints.dividendProposal: Gross = published dividend per share × quantity held on the ex-dividend date (splits included). Proposed net = gross - estimated withholding tax. Without a published payment date, the credit is estimated two trading days after the ex-dividend date. Nothing is credited without your confirmation.
hints.openingDividends: The cash balance equals net deposits - purchases + sales - fees + dividends. Hence: dividends = balance - net deposits + purchases - sales + fees. The result is only right if all your earlier operations are recorded. The confirmed amount changes neither the balance nor the deposits: it completes the "Cash dividends" indicator.

proposals.title: Dividends to confirm
proposals.description: Dividends paid on your holdings since the initial state. Confirm the amount actually credited by your broker, correct it, or ignore the proposal.
proposals.quantity: Quantity held on the ex-dividend date
proposals.needsReview: Amount to check: the company's country, a possible fund exemption or the currency are uncertain. Compare with your statement before confirming.
proposals.autoAcceptedNotice: Added automatically on {{date}}: the amount was certain. Correct it if it differs from your statement.
proposals.isinLabel: Company ISIN (for an exact withholding tax and future dividends)
proposals.isinInvalid: Invalid ISIN: two country letters, nine characters and a check digit (e.g. FR0000120271).
proposals.isinSaved: ISIN saved: the withholding tax is recalculated.

openingDividends.title: Dividends already received
openingDividends.intro: Based on your initial state on {{date}} and the operations recorded before that date, here are the dividends your PEA has probably already received. Check them before confirming.
openingDividends.published: Cross-check with published dividends × quantities held: {{gross}} gross, about {{net}} net of withholding tax.

warnings.negative: The result is negative: sales or dividends are missing from the history, or the declared deposits are too high. Enter the amount from your statement.
warnings.approximate_trades: Some operations come from a CSV holdings import, at cost price: the result is approximate.
warnings.no_trades: No purchase or sale is recorded before the reference date: the result cannot be cross-checked.
warnings.mismatch: The result differs markedly from published dividends: a purchase, a sale or fees may be missing. Check against your statement.

openingDividends.notConfirmed: Dividends received before {{date}} are not confirmed yet: calculate them from your initial state.
openingDividends.certifiedLines_one: {{count}} certified statement line, shown in the history (Received dividend).
openingDividends.certifiedLines_other: {{count}} certified statement lines, shown in the history (Received dividend).

verification.info: Certified or verified: what is the difference?
verification.hint: “Certified by statement”: the amount and date were found identically on a coupon statement from your broker, read by the app. “Manually verified”: you confirmed the amount yourself. The statement prevails: a manual verification never replaces a certification, and correcting a certified dividend removes its certification.
verification.statementHelp: Attach the coupon statement for the payment month: it is read, then discarded.

outcomes.match: The statement contains this dividend, with the same amount and date.
outcomes.already_certified: This dividend is already certified by this statement.
outcomes.amount_mismatch: Different amount: {{expected}} expected, {{found}} on the statement.
outcomes.date_mismatch: Different date: credited on {{expected}}, paid on {{found}} according to the statement.
outcomes.not_found: This statement does not contain this dividend at this date.
outcomes.other_month: Statement for another month ({{period}}): attach the one for the payment month.
outcomes.unknown_isin: This asset's ISIN is unknown: enter it to match the statement.

verification.noLines: No line for this asset on this statement.
verification.correctAndCertify: Correct with the statement and certify
verification.uncertifyWarning: This dividend is certified by a statement: correcting it will remove its certification.

statements.title: Coupon and dividend statements (PDF)
statements.help: Import one or more monthly statements from your broker to certify your dividends and capital repayments. PDFs are read then forgotten: only the date, ISIN and amounts are kept.
statements.rejected: Statement rejected, nothing will be imported from it: {{error}}

cases.certify: Recorded dividend found: it will be certified.
cases.mismatch: Recorded as {{amount}} on {{date}}: it will be corrected with the statement values, then certified.
cases.proposal: Proposed dividend: it will be accepted with the statement net amount and certified.
cases.create: No dividend recorded: it will be added to cash and certified.
cases.opening: Before the initial state: already included in the balance, never credited.
cases.unknown_asset: ISIN unknown in the portfolio: choose the matching position.

statements.possibleDuplicate: A dividend entered without an asset, with the same amount, exists at a close date: check it is not the same one before applying.
statements.openingText: Lines before {{date}}: {{amount}} in total. Confirmed amount: {{declared}} (gap {{gap}}). These lines are always kept to reconcile cash statements; tick the box to replace the confirmed amount with their total.
statements.openingCertify: Certify this amount as dividends already received
statements.result: {{certified}} certified, {{corrected}} corrected, {{created}} added, {{alreadyCertified}} already certified, {{skipped}} not applied, {{errors}} error(s), including {{refunds}} capital repayment(s).

refundCases.certify: Recorded repayment found: it will be certified.
refundCases.ambiguous: Several recorded repayments match: choose the one that matches this line.
refundCases.create: No repayment recorded: it will be added to cash (neither a deposit nor a dividend) and certified.

statements.refundBeforeStart: Before the initial state: recorded for reference, without effect on the balance, and deducted from dividends already received.
statements.refundDuplicate: A repayment with another amount exists at a close date for this security: check it is not the same one before applying.

cashStatements.title: Cash statements (PDF)
cashStatements.info: What is the cash statement for?
cashStatements.hint: Your broker's monthly cash statement is the reference for every money movement of the PEA. Each purchase, sale, dividend, deposit or other credit found to the cent gets the “Verified by cash statement” badge. It does not replace trade confirmations or coupon statements (price, fees, ISIN): it confirms them. PDFs are read then forgotten: only dates, labels, amounts, quantities and abbreviated security names are kept, never the IBAN or your name.
cashStatements.help: Import your monthly cash statements, even several years at once, to verify each operation, create deposits and flag what is missing.
cashStatements.balances: Opening balance {{opening}} on {{openingDate}}, closing balance {{closing}} on {{closingDate}}.
cashStatements.alreadyImported: Statement already imported: only lines still unmatched can be matched.
cashStatements.nothingToDo: Nothing to do for this statement.
cashStatements.beforeStart: Before the initial state: verifies the history, no effect on the balance.
cashStatements.result: {{statements}} statement(s) saved, {{verified}} operation(s) verified, {{created}} created, {{alreadyVerified}} already verified, {{unmatched}} still unmatched, {{errors}} error(s).

cases.verify: Found in the app: it will be verified.
cases.ambiguous: Several operations match: choose the one on this line.
cases.missing_trade: Missing trade confirmation: import it, then import this statement again. Nothing is created.
cases.missing_dividend: No coupon statement line for this dividend before the initial state: import (or import again) the coupon statement for that month, then import this statement again.
cases.opening: Before the initial state: already included in the declared amounts, nothing is created.
cases.neutral: Balance carried over from the former account: neutral transfer, neither deposit nor credit.

create.deposit: Deposit missing from the app: it will be created and verified.
create.withdrawal: Withdrawal missing from the app: it will be created and verified.
create.fee: Fees missing from the app: they will be created and verified.
create.capital_repayment: Missing capital repayment: it will be created (neither deposit nor dividend) and verified.
create.compensation: Missing compensation: it will be created (neither deposit nor dividend) and verified.
create.dividend: Coupon missing from the app: choose the position to add and verify it.

continuity.account_change: Account change: the balance of the {{previous}} statement is carried over (neutral transfer).
continuity.gapQuiet: No statement for {{months}}: the balance carries on, probably months without operations.
continuity.gapMissing: Missing statement for {{months}}: the balance does not carry on from the {{previous}} statement.
continuity.balance_break: The opening balance does not match the closing balance of the {{previous}} statement.

check.label: Cash statement
check.to_verifyTitle: No imported cash statement covers this operation yet.
check.not_foundTitle: This period is covered by imported cash statements, but this operation is not on them: likely a duplicate or an error.

cashStatements.unverifyWarning: This operation is verified by a cash statement: editing or deleting it will remove this verification.

monthlyCheck.title: Monthly account check
monthlyCheck.hint: Each month, the closing balance of the cash statement is compared with the balance computed by the app on the same date (a verified operation counts on its booking date on the statement).
monthlyCheck.empty: No elapsed month to check yet: each closed month covered by your cash statements will appear here.
monthlyCheck.nothingToReview: Nothing to review: every imported statement matches the app.

statusTitles.ok: The statement balance and the app balance are equal to the cent.
statusTitles.mismatch: The app balance differs from the statement: see the possible causes.
statusTitles.opening: Month closed before the start date: summarised by the initial state, it is not compared.
statusTitles.quiet: No statement, but the balance carries over and the app has no operation that month: probably a month without operations.
statusTitles.missing: Cash statement for this month to import.

monthlyCheck.monthDifference: Difference arising this month: {{amount}} (the rest comes from previous months).
monthlyCheck.missingCouponStatements: {{count}} coupon(s) or repayment(s) without a coupon statement
monthlyCheck.statementLine: Statement line {{reference}}, missing from the app
monthlyCheck.appEntry: App operation missing from the statement (likely duplicate or error)

fullHistory.title: Full history
fullHistory.description: Your cash statements can replace the initial state of {{date}}: deposits become the actual dated transfers, dividends before that date become real verified movements, and the annualized return becomes available.
fullHistory.dividends: {{count}} dividend(s) certified by coupon statements become movements: {{amount}}
fullHistory.differences: Amounts in orange differ: the declared initial state was inaccurate, the cash statements prevail.
fullHistory.negative: The replayed balance goes below zero on {{date}} (operation written before its funding): check this date after switching.
fullHistory.confirmDescription: The initial state will be deleted and replaced by the operations read on your cash statements, in a single recorded operation. Indicators will be recalculated since the PEA was opened.
fullHistory.done: Full history since the PEA was opened, verified by cash statements (switched on {{date}}).

blockers.not_ready: Set up the cash account first.
blockers.no_statements: Import your cash statements since the PEA was opened (Settings).
blockers.first_statement_not_opening: The first imported statement does not start at €0 with the opening transfer: import the statements since opening.
blockers.continuity_break_one: A statement does not continue the previous balance: a statement is probably missing.
blockers.continuity_break_other: {{count}} statements do not continue the previous balance: statements are probably missing.
blockers.not_covered: The imported statements end before the start date: import the following ones.
blockers.missing_trade_notices_one: A buy or sell on the statement has no trade: import the trade notice, then re-import the cash statement.
blockers.missing_trade_notices_other: {{count}} buys or sells on the statements have no trade: import the trade notices, then re-import the cash statements.
blockers.missing_coupon_statements_one: A coupon on the statement is not certified: import the coupon statement, then re-import the cash statement.
blockers.missing_coupon_statements_other: {{count}} coupons on the statements are not certified: import the coupon statements, then re-import the cash statements.
blockers.unmatched_entries_one: An operation in the app, before the start date, is missing from the statements (likely duplicate or error).
blockers.unmatched_entries_other: {{count}} operations in the app, before the start date, are missing from the statements (likely duplicates or errors).
blockers.unmatched_coupon_lines_one: A dividend certified by a coupon statement is not found on the cash statements.
blockers.unmatched_coupon_lines_other: {{count}} dividends certified by coupon statements are not found on the cash statements.
blockers.coupon_without_position_one: A certified dividend matches no position: enter the position's ISIN.
blockers.coupon_without_position_other: {{count}} certified dividends match no position: enter the positions' ISIN.
